description: Calculate an employee Net Promoter Score (eNPS) from survey response counts: the percentage of promoters minus the percentage of detractors, from -100 to +100. Use it when you have the count of people who answered 9-10 (promoters), 7-8 (passives) and 0-6 (detractors) to the question 'How likely are you to recommend working here?'. Returns the score, both percentages and a rule-of-thumb reading (not a universal benchmark).
name: enps_score
